svg.text: DOCK · how it goes together
Exploded side view (from the right), module at the left (the player's side) · 1 mm = 6 px
Two separate builds that meet at one face. Only power and UART cross it (common §1 joint rule):
never ±10 V, a DAC CV, an audio-path pot or audio. Numbers = build steps (14 in total).
Checked against eng v2 §4.1 (D stays with B), §4.2, §5b · common-how-it-works §1 · dock/how-it-works
Knobs: bought skirted caps + 26 mm hero; fader caps
last on
Panel sandwich A over B (same panel PCB as SLAB)
speaker Ø40 in the A/B notch, rear right
Board D reshaped as a 270 × 30 strip behind A/B (E6)
charger here, next to the single USB-C (E3)
Body frame: ≈ 9 laser-cut acrylic layers
front face carries the pogo pins + 2 cleats
Dock face: 7 pogo pins (body) · ENIG pads + notch (module)
brass cleats bolt through the front layers
Module keys: 80 mm service-cut lever tops on a bought pivot rod
each over a bought Hall low-profile switch; felt stops
Switch board (strip C) + key Pico, in the module
notes go to the body over UART
2 LiPo pouch cells in the module
VBAT crosses the dock on paired pins
Module shell: ≈ 5 layers + 9 mm skirt
the skirt sleeves over the body when carried
Two base plates (body, module), screws
battery swap: module base
← player (front)
